usedFor: Instantly runs outreach campaigns, and HubSpot receives a deal when “Create Deal” follows “New Lead in Campaign”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead in Campaign” in Instantly, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new lead in an outreach campaign becomes a HubSpot deal your sales team can work.

watchOut: “New Lead in Campaign” is polling and tied to one campaign, so the deal appears after a scheduled check.
